title: Validated Versatility
slide_intent: Compare physical and digital encounters because recognition must survive changes in scale and viewing context.
strategic_value: Shared purple, creator content and Twitch identification can connect an event audience with the everyday product.
demonstration: An annotated board pairs a TwitchCon stage photograph at upper left with a desktop interface at lower right; orange arrows and stage/screen labels connect them.
practical_value: Check which identity cues remain visible between environmental graphics and a dense interface.

content_islands.name: Stage photograph
content_islands.spec: Place the purple-lit event and audience at upper left with the orange stage label below.

content_islands.name: Product screenshot
content_islands.spec: Overlap the lower right with a desktop discovery screen on a purple field.

content_islands.name: Comparison arrows
content_islands.spec: Connect the stage and screen with orange arrows, retaining the small mark annotation.

reference_purposes.Intent: The accompanying caption explains testing identity across touchpoints to retain consistency and recognition.
